purpose: Ninth expanded public source layer focused on cyclic depsipeptides and lipopeptides, prenylated meroterpenoid tailoring, polyamine and DNA-crosslinker critique, lipidated peptide and glycolipid immunomodulators, enediyne/polyene chromophores, halogen/chalcogen bonding motifs, reversible covalent fragment probes, and stable-isotope metabolomics standards.

promotion_requirements: explicit precursor structures before template or proposal promotion
separate depsipeptide, lipopeptide, prenylation, cytotoxic-crosslinker, glycolipid, polyene, halogen/chalcogen, covalent-fragment, or isotope-label policy

route-specific macrocycle topology, ester/amide pattern, lipid tail, prenylation site, DNA-reactive motif, amphiphile geometry, chromophore geometry, noncovalent-interaction geometry, warhead reversibility, and label-position review
toxicology, antimicrobial, immunology, cytotoxicity, genotoxicity, photostability, element-specific, covalent-inhibitor, isotope-handling, or analytical-method review where relevant
safety_scope: records intentionally avoid quantities, operational procedures, and synthesis conditions
cytotoxic, DNA-reactive, immunomodulatory, covalent-fragment, chalcogen/halogen, and isotope-label entries are high-level route priors only

families.name: Cyclic depsipeptides, lipopeptides, and ester-rich peptide natural products
families.strategic_principle: Separate peptide sequence, ester/amide pattern, lipid tail, and macrocycle closure from ordinary peptide coupling. Depsipeptide and lipopeptide topology is route-defining metadata.

families.name: Prenylated terpenes, meroterpenoids, and late oxidative tailoring
families.strategic_principle: Expose prenylation site, terpene or aromatic partner, cyclization branch, and oxidative tailoring order. Prenyl groups are strategic handles when they define biosynthetic lineage or skeletal topology.

families.name: Polyamine conjugates, alkylators, and DNA-crosslinking cytotoxic scaffold critique
families.strategic_principle: Separate delivery or transport polyamine motifs, DNA-reactive groups, prodrug activation, and crosslinking mechanism from ordinary amine/alkyl substituent logic. These records are compliance-gated critique sources only.

families.name: Lipidated peptides, glycolipid antigens, and immunomodulatory amphiphiles
families.strategic_principle: Separate polar headgroup, peptide or glycan epitope, lipid tail geometry, and innate-immunity mode. Amphiphile topology and biological recognition are route metadata.

families.name: Polyene, enediyne, carotenoid, and conjugated natural-product chromophores
families.strategic_principle: Treat conjugation geometry, ene-yne topology, redox sensitivity, photostability, and chromophore biosynthesis as strategic. Polyene geometry is not an ordinary alkene count.

families.name: Halogen-bond and chalcogen-bond medicinal motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate atom placement for directional noncovalent interactions from generic halogen or sulfur substitution. Interaction geometry and element-specific liability are route metadata.

families.name: Fragment linking, reversible covalent probes, and reactivity-tuned inhibitor motifs
families.strategic_principle: Separate fragment lineage, linker growth, reversible warhead tuning, and target residue context. Covalent or semi-permanent probe handles must not be promoted without reactivity and biological-mode review.

families.name: Stable-isotope labels, metabolomics standards, and isotope-coded analytical handles
families.strategic_principle: Separate target analyte synthesis from isotope placement, isotopic purity, derivatization tag, and analytical method. Label position is strategic metadata, not a decorative atom substitution.

anchors.name: Peptide natural-product topology with reviewed ester/amide pattern, lipid tail, and macrocycle closure
Prenylated or meroterpenoid scaffold with reviewed prenylation site and tailoring branch
Polyamine, alkylator, or crosslinker motif with reviewed transport, activation, and cytotoxic mechanism
Lipidated peptide or glycolipid antigen with headgroup, tail, and immune-mode metadata
Conjugated polyene, enediyne, or carotenoid chromophore with geometry and stability metadata
Halogen or chalcogen motif with directional noncovalent interaction geometry
Fragment-linked or reversible covalent probe with target residue and warhead tuning metadata
Stable-isotope-labeled analyte or internal standard with label position and method metadata

disconnections.name: Cyclic depsipeptide to linear precursor plus ester/amide pattern and macrocycle closure policy

forward_logic: map the linear sequence and ester/amide pattern before scoring closure
separate fragment assembly from macrocyclization and late chirality control
track biological class and stereochemical topology
suggested_precursor_roles: hydroxy acid or amino acid fragment
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that expose ester/amide order and macrocycle topology instead of treating the target as a generic peptide.

evidence.citation: Cyclic depsipeptide review links molecular architecture to antibacterial functions.
Macrocyclic natural-product synthesis review discusses late-stage chirality generation strategies.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit ester/amide pattern and macrocycle topology

disconnections.name: Lipopeptide to peptide core plus lipid-tail and surfactant or antimicrobial policy

break_bonds: lipid tail to peptide core boundary
peptide headgroup to macrocycle or acyl-tail boundary
forward_logic: separate peptide core assembly from lipid-tail installation
track membrane-active, surfactant, or antimicrobial role before proposal promotion
avoid treating long-chain acylated peptides as ordinary amides
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use lipopeptide entries only when lipid-tail topology and biological role are explicit.

evidence.citation: Fusaricidin review provides public lipopeptide natural-product context.
Microbe-derived surfactant review discusses anti-biofilm surfactant molecules including lipopeptide-like contexts.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit peptide core, lipid tail, and membrane or antimicrobial context

disconnections.name: Prenylated meroterpenoid to aromatic/polyketide core plus prenyl donor and site policy

break_bonds: prenyl group to aromatic or polyketide core boundary
terpene fragment to non-terpene core boundary
forward_logic: map prenylation site and core partner before route scoring
separate core assembly from prenyl installation and oxidative tailoring
track biosynthetic branch where it changes scaffold topology
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward explicit prenyl-site and core-partner mapping rather than generic alkyl substitution.

evidence.citation: Bisabosqual study provides public context for fungal triprenyl phenol meroterpenoids and synthesis.
Plant prenyltransferase review covers diversity and production of prenylated natural products.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit prenylation site, core partner, and tailoring order

disconnections.name: Terpene or prenylated scaffold to cyclization branch plus late tailoring policy

forward_logic: separate prenyltransferase or terpene branch choice from downstream editing
track whether late oxidation, rearrangement, or peptide prenylation defines the target family
keep biosynthetic branch metadata advisory until structures are explicit
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use biosynthetic tailoring entries to critique route order, not to accept advanced natural-product analogues as stock.

evidence.citation: Amino acid and peptide prenyltransferase review discusses discovery, engineering, and applications.
Meroterpenoid biosynthesis search result provides public context for meroterpenoid tailoring families.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit branch and tailoring-order metadata

disconnections.name: Polyamine conjugate to payload scaffold plus transport or uptake policy

forward_logic: separate polyamine transporter or metabolism motif from the payload scaffold
track uptake, immune, ferroptosis, or therapy-resistance context
flag cytotoxic or oncology use before proposal promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Treat polyamine conjugates as advisory unless transport role and payload identity are explicit.

evidence.citation: Naphthalimide polyamine conjugate review discusses polyamine conjugates in cancer treatment context.
Polyamine metabolism review discusses cancer immune evasion, ferroptosis, and therapy resistance.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit transporter/metabolism rationale and payload mapping

disconnections.name: DNA alkylator or crosslinker to activation/prodrug motif plus DNA-reactive scaffold policy

break_bonds: prodrug trigger to cytotoxic motif boundary
DNA-reactive handle to carrier scaffold boundary
forward_logic: separate cytotoxic pharmacophore from activation, delivery, or masking motif
track DNA adduct/crosslink mechanism and tumor-selective activation rationale
keep all entries compliance-gated and advisory only
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use crosslinker records for route-risk critique, not operational proposal generation.

evidence.citation: Nitrogen mustard prodrug review discusses tumor-selective and chemical activation strategies.
DNA adduct review covers DNA adducts in cancer chemotherapy.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit activation, DNA-reactive motif, and route-risk control metadata

disconnections.name: Glycolipid antigen to polar headgroup plus lipid-tail geometry and immune-recognition policy

break_bonds: glycan headgroup to lipid aglycone boundary
forward_logic: separate headgroup identity from lipid-tail and stereochemical geometry
track antigen presentation, iNKT recognition, and immunomodulatory context
avoid generic glycoside or lipid-stock closure
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that preserve headgroup/tail geometry and immune-recognition context.

evidence.citation: iNKT immunotherapy review discusses lipid-based modulation and translational advances.
iNKT agonist review discusses vaccine adjuvant applications for infectious disease.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit headgroup, tail geometry, and immune-recognition metadata

disconnections.name: Lipidated peptide adjuvant to peptide epitope plus lipid amphiphile policy

break_bonds: lipid tail to peptide epitope boundary
forward_logic: separate peptide epitope synthesis from lipidation and adjuvant role
track innate-immunity receptor or delivery mechanism
flag vaccine/adjuvant review before proposal-source promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use lipidated peptide entries only when epitope, lipid tail, and immune-mode role are explicit.

evidence.citation: Peptide vaccine delivery review discusses lipids as activators of innate immunity.
TLR2 vaccine review provides public context for lipopeptide-like immune targeting.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit peptide/lipid boundary and immune-mode metadata

disconnections.name: Enediyne or polyene chromophore to scaffold plus conjugation and activation policy

forward_logic: define chromophore geometry and attachment to carrier scaffold
separate conjugated system construction from glycoside, polyketide, or carrier fragments
track redox, photostability, and cytotoxicity context
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward routes that preserve chromophore geometry and activation context rather than generic alkyne/alkene edits.

evidence.citation: Enediyne antibiotic genome-mining review supports enediyne motifs as distinct natural-product source families.
Anthraquinone-fused enediyne review discusses discovery, biosynthesis, and development.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit chromophore geometry, carrier boundary, and activation/stability context

disconnections.name: Carotenoid or retinoid-like polyene to terminal groups plus conjugation-geometry policy

break_bonds: polyene chain to terminal group boundary
forward_logic: separate terminal groups from conjugated chain and geometry control
track stability, bioavailability, and photochemical liabilities
avoid scoring any polyene assembly without geometry metadata
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use carotenoid/retinoid-like entries only when polyene geometry and stability role are explicit.

evidence.citation: Carotenoid stability review discusses physicochemical stability and delivery concerns.
Retinoid biology review links quantum chemistry and retinoid biological function.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit chain geometry, terminal groups, and stability metadata

disconnections.name: Halogen-bond donor motif to parent scaffold plus directional interaction policy

target_features: fluorinated or halogenated motif with geometry rationale

break_bonds: halogen-bond donor motif to parent scaffold boundary
CF2X or halogenated interaction group boundary
forward_logic: define parent scaffold and the intended halogen-bond geometry
separate interaction-motif installation from generic halogenation
track binding-site evidence and element-specific exposure context
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward halogenated motifs only when directional interaction geometry is explicit.

evidence.citation: CF2X halogen-bond donor review discusses applications in medicinal chemistry, chemical biology, and drug discovery.
Charge-density analysis review provides public context for evaluating noncovalent interactions in molecular crystals.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit interaction geometry and parent-scaffold mapping

disconnections.name: Chalcogen-bond or organosulfur/selenium motif to parent scaffold plus element-specific policy

break_bonds: chalcogen motif to parent scaffold boundary
organosulfur or organoselenium interaction group boundary
forward_logic: separate element-specific motif synthesis from parent scaffold assembly
track whether the motif is a binding interaction, redox liability, or metabolism handle
require toxicology and biological-mode review before promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use chalcogen motifs as advisory priors unless interaction geometry and element-specific liability are explicit.

evidence.citation: Chalcogen bond scaffold study discusses chalcogen bond-assisted syn-locked scaffolds and biological implications.
Sulfur-containing molecule review provides public medicinal context for sulfur motif strategy.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate only with element-specific binding and toxicity metadata

disconnections.name: Reversible covalent inhibitor to recognition fragment plus tuned warhead and target-residue policy

forward_logic: separate recognition fragment from warhead and linker
track target residue, reversibility, reactivity, and selectivity evidence
gate all covalent-fragment entries before proposal promotion
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward covalent-fragment routes only when target residue and reactivity tuning are explicit.

evidence.citation: Covalent inhibitor review discusses progress on covalent inhibitors targeting alkaline amino acids.
bioTCI review discusses middle-to-macro biomolecular targeted covalent inhibitors.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit fragment lineage, target residue, and reactivity tuning

disconnections.name: Fragment-linked probe to fragment lineage plus linker and handle policy

break_bonds: probe handle to recognition scaffold boundary
forward_logic: map each fragment to SAR lineage before scoring the linked target
separate probe handle from recognition scaffold and linker
track whether covalent action is intended, reversible, or avoided
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use fragment-linking records to preserve SAR lineage and avoid treating probe handles as target-stock shortcuts.

evidence.citation: Targeted covalent inhibitor review provides public context for covalent probe design and specificity.
Covalent inhibitor review supports reactivity and target-residue metadata as route-relevant policy.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit fragment lineage, linker topology, and probe-handle role

disconnections.name: Stable-isotope-labeled analyte to unlabeled analyte plus label-position policy

break_bonds: isotope-labeled fragment to analyte scaffold boundary
forward_logic: map labeled atoms to the unlabeled analyte before route scoring
separate analyte synthesis from isotope source and label-position policy
track isotopic purity and analytical method
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Reward labeled-standard routes only when label position, isotopic purity, and analyte mapping are explicit.

evidence.citation: Quantitative metabolomics review discusses challenges and advances in mass-spectrometry-based metabolomics.
Multiple-isotope fluxomics review discusses use of isotopes in metabolic analysis.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: high for explicit label-position and analyte-mapping metadata

disconnections.name: Metabolomics standard to analyte plus isotope-coded derivatization or internal-standard policy

forward_logic: separate analyte-specific synthesis from derivatization-tag installation
track whether isotope coding is internal standard, derivatization, or flux analysis
avoid treating labeled standards as ordinary stock unless analytical metadata is present
retrosynthetic_move.planner_hint: Use isotope-coded standard entries for analytical route policy and label traceability, not generic synthetic closure.

evidence.citation: Isotope-coded derivatization review discusses LC-MS biomedical applications.
Acyl-CoA analytical review discusses internal standards and mass-spectrometry quantitation context.

use_policy.rerank_bonus: moderate for explicit derivatization, label, and analytical-method metadata

source_notes.summary: The v10 expansion promotes the refreshed backlog families for depsipeptide/lipopeptide topology, prenylated meroterpenoid tailoring, polyamine and cytotoxic crosslinker critique, lipidated immunomodulators, polyene/enediyne chromophores, halogen/chalcogen bonding motifs, reversible covalent fragment probes, and stable-isotope metabolomics standards.

Cytotoxic, genotoxic, immunomodulatory, antimicrobial, covalent-probe, chalcogen/halogen, chromophore, and isotope-label records are advisory. Promotion to proposal generation requires explicit safety, biological-mode, toxicology, immunology, analytical-method, or element-specific review as applicable.
